ns2:section.sectionText: This course is a second 8-week course and meets October 17th - December 5th as well as a mandatory field trip to Ecuador over the winter break. There is a program fee $TBD, which includes round-trip airfare from Chicago, lodging, on the ground transportation costs, all program-related activities, and most meals. Scholarships are available. Please contact the ACES Study Abroad Office at aces-studyabroad@illinois.edu for more information.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr, Consumer, & Env Sciences.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
